title: ULTRAKILL

Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on DXVK on the default engine r11 on an M2 after a short session of ten minutes, with nothing named as off. The bottle had been set up for Counter-Strike 2, whose recipe writes a dxvk.conf section for csgo.exe alone, so none of it reaches this game. No report has tried DXMT on it yet.
